<function name="SetRenderInScreenshots" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets whenever the panel should be rendered in a screenshot. (`jpeg` or `screenshot` commands, Camera SWEP)</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="renderInScreenshot" type="boolean">Whether to render in the screenshot or not.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
